typedModel: DRW_Material retains opacity percent/map controls and a separate 16-element row-major transform with documented defaults and presence flags.

Copy/reset behavior preserves the typed opacity fields and restores defaults/identity with presence false.
parser: Type groups 140/141/175/7/176/177/178/142 before the post-map 464/465 Normal Map boundary.
Validate finite opacity reals and matrix values, source/projection/tiling domains, and the documented auto-transform flag mask without adding undocumented scalar ranges.
Require exactly 16 contiguous matrix reals; reject incomplete matrices at the next group and reject excess values immediately.
Preserve the exact ordered raw net, including post-boundary reused codes.
writer: Emit groups 140/141/175/7/176/177/178 followed by all 16 group-142 row-major values when present.
Reject invalid authored domains and non-finite opacity values before output replacement.
boundedTextRegression: The focused MATERIAL retained-owner CTest checks exact-cap group-7 filename replacement in ASCII and Binary DXF.
At one byte under the cap, the previous opacity filename remains intact while the earlier map filename replacements remain admitted; copy/reset accounting releases the shared lease correctly.

generatedControls: ASCII and Binary MATERIAL records carry distinct opacity fields and a non-identity 16-value opacity mapper, followed by a LINE sentinel.
Assert typed values, exact raw group order, same-encoding replay, cross-encoding replay, copy/reset/default behavior, and isolation from the later Normal Map block.
Reject invalid source/projection/tiling/auto-transform values, non-finite ASCII opacity percent/blend/matrix values, and 15-/17-value matrices before callback publication.
Typed writer round-trips every field and asserts schema order; invalid domains and non-finite fields preserve prior output and succeed after correction.
No persistent test drawing is added; malformed ASCII numeric values are applied only to locally generated temporary files.
